name: io.github.JonathanRReed/apple-calendar-mcp
title: Apple Calendar
description: List, create, update, and delete events in Apple Calendar on macOS.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_CALENDAR_MCP_SAFETY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safety mode for Calendar operations: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_CALENDAR_MCP_ALLOWED_CALENDARS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of calendar names. Empty allows all calendars.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_CALENDAR_MCP_WRITE_ALLOWED_CALENDARS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of calendar names that may be written to (create/update/delete). Reads are unaffected, so a client can see every calendar while only being able to modify these. Empty applies no write-specific restriction.
